_note: Hand-written one-liners merged by scripts/db-map.mjs (precedence: DB COMMENT > this file > migration header). Edit freely; prefer COMMENT ON in a migration for new objects.

tables.app.audit_log: Row-level audit trail (actor, entity_type, entity_id, action, diff jsonb) written by seller-side routes.
tables.app.auth_signin_attempts: Failed-login counter + lockout per identifier (identifier, failed_count, locked_until).
tables.app.buyer_app_activity: Buyer-app event stream (catalog_viewed, session_started, estimate_created…) with occurred_day; feeds engagement/metrics.
tables.app.buyer_users: Staff/assistant logins under a buyer (role buyer_admin|buyer_assistant, own phone + auth user). Owner login is app.buyers itself.
tables.app.buyers: Customers of a tenant (distributor). phone = 10-digit login identity; buyer_app_enabled gates the buyer app; default_cohort_id; Zoho-synced via external_ref.
tables.app.campaign_buyer_members: Materialised buyer audience of a campaign (buyer_target_mode customer_group/manual), refreshed by the membership tick.
tables.app.campaign_items: Products in a campaign. price_override = campaign price (derived from the price list when campaigns.pricing_source='pricelist'; NULL/0 = no campaign price).
tables.app.campaign_views: One row per buyer×campaign×day view; engagement signal.
tables.app.campaigns: Seller promotions: scope (all/cohort/buyer/geography), validity window, pricing_source (pricelist|individual_prices), price_list_id, status draft|published.
tables.app.cohort_members: Buyer membership of a cohort (valid_from/valid_until). Read via cohort_members_active for current members.
tables.app.cohorts: Customer groups. membership_mode automatic (rules jsonb, e.g. buyer_app=enabled) or manual/static; cached_member_count.
tables.app.estimate_items: Line items of an estimate: qty, unit_price (price the buyer was quoted), tax, line_total.
tables.app.estimates: Buyer quotes/enquiries (buyer-app or seller-created): status, campaign_id attribution, totals, estimate_number, sent channel.
tables.app.integration_analytics_events: Telemetry of integration runs (Zoho sync outcomes) (unverified)
tables.app.integration_data_flows: Configured sync flows per integration (entity types, direction) (unverified)
tables.app.integration_entity_map: Maps Yukti rows to external system ids (Zoho) per tenant integration.
tables.app.integration_oauth_states: Short-lived OAuth state for connecting integrations (WhatsApp/Zoho).
tables.app.integration_sync_jobs: Sync job runs/queue per tenant integration with status and progress.
tables.app.integration_webhook_echo_guards: Suppresses echo of our own writes coming back via webhooks.
tables.app.integration_webhook_errors: Failed webhook processing records for replay/diagnosis.
tables.app.integration_webhook_event_changes: Per-event field-level changes parsed from webhook payloads (unverified)
tables.app.integration_webhook_events: Raw inbound webhook events (Zoho) awaiting/after persist; pruned after 14 days.
tables.app.integration_webhooks: Registered webhook endpoints per tenant integration (is_active/status).
tables.app.invoices: Sales invoices (Zoho-synced): status, due date, balance; drives dues/overdue entries.
tables.app.locations: Buyer delivery/billing locations and routed outlets.
tables.app.membership_dirty_work: Work queue for cohort/campaign/price-list membership recompute (entity_type buyer_candidate/product_candidate/cohort/...; state pending|done|dead_letter). Drained by the 15-min tick or flush_buyer_membership.
tables.app.price_list_assignments: Who a price list applies to: target_type buyer | cohort | all_buyers (resolve_prices_batch tiers).
tables.app.price_list_items: Price per product per price list (min_qty/max_qty tiers).
tables.app.price_lists: Named price lists (General, Error, …): priority, validity, pricebook_type, is_active.
tables.app.realtime_notifications: Outbox for realtime/broadcast notifications to seller UI; pruned hourly.
tables.app.reco_buyer_profiles: Per-buyer purchase profile for recommendations (weekly job).
tables.app.tenant_field_mappings: Field mapping config between Yukti and external systems per tenant (unverified)
tables.app.tenant_integrations: Connected integrations per tenant (Zoho, WhatsApp Business) with status/credentials refs.
tables.app.tenant_inventory: Stock per product per warehouse (qty_available, reorder_point).
tables.app.tenant_products: Tenant's sellable SKUs: base_selling_price, mrp, tax, brand/category, product_family_id, stock flags.
tables.app.tenant_settings: Per-tenant settings jsonb (buyer_app.enabled, business.logo_url, notifications.whatsapp.*, flags).
tables.app.tenant_users: Seller team members of a tenant (seller_admin|seller_assistant) with phone.
tables.app.tenants: Tenants (distributors): slug (= storefront host label), subdomain, business_name, settings.
tables.app.warehouses: Tenant warehouses/outlets used for stock routing.
tables.app.whatsapp_broadcasts: Seller broadcast campaigns (template + audience) with delivery rollups.
tables.app.whatsapp_credit_transactions: Credit ledger per tenant: debit/refund/topup, balance_after, balance_source.
tables.app.whatsapp_messages: Every outbound WhatsApp message: trigger_source (otp_login, enquiry_received, access_request_received…), status queued|sent|delivered|read|failed, recipient_phone stored as 91+10 digits, failure_reason.
tables.app.whatsapp_platform_config: Singleton (id=1) platform WhatsApp config: broadcast pause, quality rating.
tables.app.whatsapp_send_queue: Send queue 1:1 with whatsapp_messages: priority 1 = transactional, >1 = broadcast; status pending|processing|sent|failed; attempt_count; scheduled_send_at.
tables.app.whatsapp_templates: Meta templates registry (approval_status, locale, variables, buttons_config).
tables.app.zoho_token_cache: Cached Zoho OAuth access tokens (secret-bearing; never dump).
tables.catalog.brands: Master brand list reusable across tenants.
tables.catalog.categories: Master category taxonomy reusable across tenants.

functions.app.resolve_price: Price for one product×buyer×qty: buyer-assigned list > cohort list > all_buyers list > base_selling_price. Does NOT apply campaigns.
functions.app.resolve_prices_batch: Batch of resolve_price. Campaign overrides are applied in app code (buyer-product-data / buyer-price-resolution), not here.
functions.app.find_buyer_login_candidates: Phone → owner (app.buyers) + delegate (buyer_users) login candidates with tenant slug; used by OTP send.
functions.app.flush_buyer_membership: Drain ONE buyer's pending membership work synchronously (3s timeout; 'flushed'|'none'|'busy'|'failed'). Called after enable/approve and on browse.
functions.app.request_buyer_app_access: Existing app-disabled buyer asks for access: creates/reuses the approval entry (idempotent: already_requested).
functions.app.approve_buyer_access_entry: Seller approves an access entry: enables buyer app, assigns group/price list, queues Zoho push.
functions.app.apply_entry_action: Applies an inbox entry action (decline, request_more_info, resolve…).
functions.app.submit_buyer_intake: Self-registration intake: creates/reopens the buyer + business_approval entry.
functions.app.refresh_campaign_products_by_id: Recompute a campaign's product membership and (pricelist campaigns) price_override = price list price or NULL.
functions.app.evaluate_buyer_for_cohorts_v2: Re-evaluate one buyer's cohort memberships from cohort rules.
functions.app.evaluate_buyer_for_campaign_buyers: Re-evaluate one buyer's campaign audience membership.
functions.app.prepare_whatsapp_message_for_send: Claims a queued message for send: template/credit/cap checks, debits credits, marks processing.
functions.app.next_pending_whatsapp_message_batch: Next pending queue rows (used by whatsapp-queue-sweep-worker).
functions.app.whatsapp_kick_stuck_transactional: Cron (5 min): if a priority-1 row is pending >2 min, POST the sweep worker.
functions.app.whatsapp_requeue_credit_failures: Trigger fn on credit top-up: requeue last-24h transactional rows that failed for insufficient credits.
functions.app.get_functions_base_url: Base URL of Supabase edge functions for pg_net calls.
functions.app.prod_guard_tick: Prod load guard tick (every 2 min): classifies load and can pause heavy ticks.
functions.app.dispatch_buyer_zoho_pushes: Push approved buyers to Zoho (cron every 5 min or per entry).
functions.app.set_updated_at: Generic BEFORE UPDATE trigger setting updated_at.
